messages.subject: Welcome - how email back-and-forth works
messages.body:
Hi Riley - this is your From Job Search inbox.

1) On Job Search, tap Email Job Search. That opens Gmail to Brandon (Hoppb6@gmail.com) with subject JOB HUB SEARCH ASK and a packet about your query, resume target, skills, location, and live board links.

2) Brandon / Rileys Job Search replies by updating this file on the site (or you can Paste reply if fetch fails).

3) Tap Refresh, open a message, then Apply to app (or Apply & mark read). Apply merges suggested applications, searches, letter drafts, aspirations, and journal notes into your local hub - no fake jobs are seeded here.

Resume peek stays available anytime from the orange pill.
